Recharts (L5-8: BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, Cell, chartGrid, chartMargin, chartAnimation) has no native renderer — the native charts barrel's primitives render 'unavailable' placeholders — so the L123-156 chart is re-implemented with RN primitives to preserve the bar-chart visual intent: a row of flex-end vertical bars (height ∝ energy/maxEnergy with a 4% floor so tiny sessions stay visible; `maxBarSize={32}`->maxWidth 32; `radius=[4,4,0,0]`->borderTopLeft/RightRadius 4; `<Cell fill>`->per-bar `CHARGER_COLORS[d.type] ?? '#6366f1'`; web `key={i}`->index key), a YAxis tick column (width 36, three fmt(v,0) ticks max/half/0), an XAxis date-label row (dataKey 'label'), and three faint hairline gridlines for `chartGrid` (stroke=border, opacity 0.4). chartMargin.top=10 -> plot paddingTop. The Recharts hover Tooltip (no hover on touch) -> each bar's accessibilityLabel reproduces the formatter ('${fmt(energy,1)} kWh' + CHARGER_TYPE_LABEL[type] ?? type) and labelFormatter (the date label). chartAnimation (Recharts enter animation) has no native analog and is intentionally omitted (documented).
